Chapter 1049: 8 Reputation (Request For Monthly Tickets)

Chapter 1049: Chapter 8 Reputation (Request for Monthly Tickets)

“What is this Purple Dream talking about?”

Lord Qingfen frowned, “She said I’m hiding a Great Lord? Inside this city?”

If it weren’t for the genuine expression Marquis Purple Dream showed at the end, Lord Qingfen would have directly assumed she was spouting nonsense.

“A Great Lord?”

Lord Qingfen carefully probed the city again using the grand formation.

Qingfen City had long been fortified with formations specifically designed to detect the depth and gravity of life energy. If a Great Lord-level expert had infiltrated, Lord Qingfen would have detected it immediately.

“Those puppets?”

Lord Qingfen glanced at the numerous peak Dominator Realm puppets rampaging through the city. With a thought, he collected all of them.

These puppets, specifically created by the Purple Dream Domain to wreak havoc in Qingfen City and conceal their true intentions, were naturally dealt with swiftly by Lord Qingfen.

“It seems that during the hundred breaths I spent trapped in the dream, significant changes occurred within the city.”

Lord Qingfen’s eyes grew deep, and Qingfen City reflected within his gaze began to “reverse.”

As a Great Lord-level being, his proficiency in the domain of time was naturally vast, allowing him to easily “reverse” time within a specific area, like a city.

Of course, it could only “reverse” — he could not alter the past.

*Whoosh.*

Time began to flow backward.

In the blink of an eye, he arrived at the moment a hundred breaths ago.

At this moment, Qingfen City was peaceful.

Until Marquis Purple Dream descended with an incarnation.

In the instant that Lord Qingfen fell into the elaborate dream Marquis Purple Dream had woven beforehand…

A plethora of peak Dominator Realm puppets suddenly appeared across Qingfen City.

“These puppets?”

Lord Qingfen paid no heed to the puppets and focused his gaze on a group of individuals hiding in the shadows — led by a woman with purple hair.

Peak Dominator Realm puppets had limited destructive power, and before falling into the dreamscape, Lord Qingfen had already issued orders for his disciples to guard the core of the formations.

Thus, Lord Qingfen was unconcerned about these puppets posing any threat.

And indeed, when Lord Qingfen awoke, the damage caused by the peak Dominator Realm puppets to Qingfen City was negligible.

All thunder, no rain.

“Purple Dream’s scheme — carried out by them?”

Lord Qingfen surmised that the puppets were merely tools used to divert attention.

The real plan was likely to depend on these people.

Lord Qingfen continued observing.

Soon.

He saw the group led by the purple-haired woman wandering around the nodes of Qingfen City’s formations.

However, to Lord Qingfen’s surprise, the group didn’t take any action. Even when they approached the core of the formations, they lingered for just a few breaths before quietly leaving.

“What are they trying to do?”

Lord Qingfen realized something was amiss. Marquis Purple Dream had spent tens of thousands of years weaving an intricate dream and sacrificed an incarnation containing her true essence, only for her subordinates to roam around Qingfen City aimlessly?

“Could it be…?”

Lord Qingfen faintly began to form a conjecture.

At this moment.

The group led by the purple-haired woman arrived in front of the Sky Burning Court.

Unlike before, this time the group did not leave.

Instead, they actively began attacking the Sky Burning Court.

“Hmph.”

“A group of Dominators daring to lay hands on my disciples?”

Lord Qingfen sneered, having personally adjusted the formations around the Sky Burning Court to make it one of the most heavily fortified areas of Qingfen City.

With merely a dozen or so peak Dominators?

Lord Qingfen remained utterly unconcerned.

Sure enough.

When the group saw the Sky Burning Court’s formidable defenses, they immediately abandoned their efforts.

And then, something happened that left Lord Qingfen astonished.

The previously safe and secure Lin Yuan within the Sky Burning Court suddenly walked out voluntarily.

“This…”

Lord Qingfen felt puzzled.

But what occurred next deeply shook Lord Qingfen to his core.

Lin Yuan casually delivered a few slaps, obliterating the group of peak Dominator Realm experts. Then Marquis Purple Dream herself descended with another incarnation — only to be slapped to death by Lin Yuan as well.

That was Marquis Purple Dream, a Great Lord-level being.

Even though it was only an incarnation, it was far beyond what Dominator Realm cultivators could contend with.

An incarnation of a Great Lord might not be able to crush certain exceedingly powerful Dominator Realm cultivators, but it should never have been overwhelmed so effortlessly!

…

Time resumed its normal course.

Lord Qingfen fell into silence.

“My disciple… is a Great Lord?”

Lord Qingfen felt an overwhelming sense of disbelief. This group led by the purple-haired woman, including the Great Lord Marquis Purple Dream herself, merely assumed Lord Qingfen had deployed a hidden Great Lord within the city.

But he knew his own situation well.

Lord Qingfen truly hadn’t done such a thing.

Moreover, Lin Yuan was a disciple he had only recently accepted.

These were indisputable facts.

Lord Qingfen had no reason to lie about this.

“No.”

“My disciple is not a Great Lord.”

Lord Qingfen abruptly snapped out of his thoughts, realizing that the formation designed to detect critical life energy levels in the city had not triggered any warnings.

If Lin Yuan truly was a Great Lord, there was no way such a significant presence would have escaped detection.

“Not a Great Lord, yet possessing such power…?” Lord Qingfen pondered deeply, replaying the earlier scenes again.

“Fierce Sun Divine Body?”

“Has the Fierce Sun Divine Body awakened this quickly?”

Lord Qingfen’s expression shifted. “Could it be the bloodline — the Fierce Sun Bloodline?”

In the Fierce Sun Ancient Country, any being capable of condensing the Seed of the Fierce Sun possessed at least traces of the Fierce Sun Bloodline.

This bloodline belonged to the royal lineage of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country.

Of course, for typical beings, such traces of the Fierce Sun Bloodline were incredibly faint to the point of being negligible.

The royal family of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country was able to rule the entire nation precisely because the concentration of Fierce Sun Bloodline in their veins was sustained at a high level.

That said, exceptions always exist.

Even beings outside the royal family occasionally experienced bloodline regression.

When regressed, the Fierce Sun Bloodline would become especially potent, manifesting in traits such as an uncanny ability to condense Seed of the Fierce Sun and withstand Fierce Sun Radiance, allowing one’s strength to grow exponentially to reach the Dominator Realm.
